note: Kaggle public leaderboard scores, 2026-10-26. The public leaderboard scores a rotating subset of the held-out (building, weather) pairs; the private leaderboard uses the complete set.

pid_water.purpose: calibration: a baseline whose local value is known exactly, so the leaderboard can be read as a ruler

derived.comment: pid_water scores 1.17x HIGHER on the held-out set than on the published scenarios, so the evaluation set is slightly harder, not easier. The improvement transfers at 23%.

leaderboard_context.comment: Our 0.04932 is 9.5x the top score. Our energy+carbon alone is 0.0113 locally, so even with zero comfort penalty we could not reach 0.005 by this route. Reaching the top requires both near-perfect tracking and roughly a third of our energy, which is not a gain available from retuning this control structure.
